---
title: "cytoJointR vs COMPASS vs polyICSFlow: detection benchmark"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    code-fold: true
execute:
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| label: parameters
# Parameters -------------------------------------------------------------------
RUN_DIR <- Sys.getenv("BENCH_RUN_DIR", "runs/2026-11-02_benchmark") # replicates and scenarios.tsv, relative to the repo root
SUMMARY_DIR <- Sys.getenv("BENCH_SUMMARY_DIR", "runs/2026-11-02_benchmark-summary") # 08_summarise-benchmark.R tables
COVERAGE_TARGET <- 0.9 # nominal level of the cytoJointR interval
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(forcats)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
})
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 8))
read_run <- \(f) read_tsv(file.path(here::here(SUMMARY_DIR), f), show_col_types = FALSE)
scenarios <- read_tsv(file.path(here::here(RUN_DIR), "scenarios.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
scenario_levels <- scenarios$scenario_id
# One palette keyed by method label; an unknown label fails.
METHOD_COLOURS <- c(
  cytoJointR = "#D55E00",
  COMPASS_default = "#0072B2",
  COMPASS_nofilter = "#56B4E9",
  polyICSFlow_clipped = "#009E73",
  polyICSFlow_unclipped = "#999999"
)
as_method <- \(x) {
  stopifnot("unknown method label" = all(x %in% names(METHOD_COLOURS)))
  fct(x, levels = names(METHOD_COLOURS))
}
tidy_detector <- \(d) {
  d |>
    separate_wider_delim(detector, " ", names = c("method", "score")) |>
    mutate(method = as_method(method), scenario_id = fct(scenario_id, levels = scenario_levels))
}
fmt <- \(x, se) if_else(is.na(x), "-", sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", x, se))
```

## Completion

Every scenario and seed that finished is counted here; a gap is a failed task, and COMPASS failures are listed by variant.

```{r}
read_run("replicate_status.tsv") |>
  summarise(
    expected = n(),
    cytoJointR_COMPASS_done = sum(done_a),
    polyICSFlow_done = sum(done_b),
    COMPASS_default_failed = sum(status_COMPASS_default == "failed", na.rm = TRUE),
    COMPASS_nofilter_failed = sum(status_COMPASS_nofilter == "failed", na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = scenario_id
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Scenarios and achieved truth

The table gives the solved baseline and effect targets, and the true donor RMS (fraction of parent cells) actually drawn across all replicates.

```{r}
scenarios |>
  select(scenario_id, generator, target_baseline = baseline, target_rms = rms) |>
  left_join(read_run("truth_summary.tsv"), join_by(scenario_id), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## ROC curves

Each panel pools the donors of all seeds, with responders of the scenario against donors of the null scenario (first figure) or against the scenario's own non-responders (second figure, only where both exist); colour is the method, with cytoJointR P(RMS > eps), COMPASS Response() and polyICSFlow clipped net as its score.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 5
ROC_SCORES <- c("P_RMS_gt_eps", "Response", "net_sum") # one score per method in the ROC figures; every score is in the AUC table
roc <- read_run("roc_curves.tsv") |>
  tidy_detector() |>
  filter(score %in% ROC_SCORES, method != "polyICSFlow_unclipped")
plot_roc <- \(cmp) {
  ggplot(filter(roc, comparison == cmp), aes(fpr, tpr, colour = method)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, drop = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(vars(scenario_id), nrow = 2) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = "False positive rate", y = "True positive rate")
}
plot_roc("vs_null")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 3
plot_roc("within")
```

## AUC

AUC is the pooled Mann-Whitney AUC over donors and seeds, with the standard error from resampling seeds in brackets; `-` means one class is absent.

```{r}
#| results: asis
auc <- read_run("auc.tsv") |> tidy_detector()
for (cmp in c("vs_null", "within")) {
  cat("\n\n**", cmp, "**\n\n")
  auc |>
    filter(comparison == cmp) |>
    mutate(cell = fmt(auc, se)) |>
    select(method, score, scenario_id, cell) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = scenario_id, values_from = cell) |>
    arrange(method, score) |>
    knitr::kable() |>
    print()
}
```

## Detection at the conventional rules

Sensitivity is the fraction of responders called and specificity the fraction of non-responders not called, at cytoJointR P > 0.95, COMPASS Response() > 0.5 (our choice, COMPASS gives no rule) and polyICSFlow clipped net > 0.

```{r}
read_run("rules.tsv") |>
  mutate(cell = fmt(estimate, se), scenario_id = fct(scenario_id, levels = scenario_levels)) |>
  select(detector, rate, scenario_id, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = scenario_id, values_from = cell) |>
  arrange(rate, detector) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Magnitude of the donor RMS

Each grey point is one seed's bias or RMSE of the estimated donor RMS against the truth (fraction scale), and the black bar is the mean over seeds.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
mag <- read_run("magnitude_replicate.tsv") |>
  mutate(method = as_method(method), scenario_id = fct(scenario_id, levels = scenario_levels)) |>
  pivot_longer(c(bias, rmse), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")
ggplot(mag, aes(method, value)) +
  geom_hline(data = tibble(metric = "bias"), aes(yintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(colour = "grey50", alpha = 0.6, size = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ scenario_id, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimate - truth (fraction of parent cells)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))
```

The cytoJointR 90% interval covers the true donor RMS in the fraction of donors below, with the across-seed SE.

```{r}
read_run("magnitude.tsv") |>
  filter(method == "cytoJointR") |>
  mutate(coverage = fmt(coverage, coverage_se), scenario_id = fct(scenario_id, levels = scenario_levels)) |>
  arrange(scenario_id) |>
  select(scenario_id, n_seeds, coverage) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Pattern-level detection

AUC over donor by pattern, with responding patterns defined by the true change above the pattern threshold; COMPASS patterns removed by its filter score 0, and `-` means one class is absent.

```{r}
pattern_auc <- read_run("pattern_auc.tsv") |> tidy_detector()
pattern_auc |>
  mutate(cell = fmt(auc, se)) |>
  select(method, score, scenario_id, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = scenario_id, values_from = cell) |>
  arrange(method, score) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 3
ggplot(drop_na(pattern_auc, auc), aes(auc, scenario_id, colour = method, shape = score)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = auc - se, xmax = auc + se), size = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Pattern-level AUC (point, +- 1 SE over seeds)", y = NULL)
```

## Runtime

Each grey point is one replicate's wall-clock seconds for the method (log scale), the black bar is the median, and the table gives the CPUs used.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 3
rt <- read_run("runtime_replicate.tsv") |> mutate(method = fct(method))
ggplot(rt, aes(method, seconds)) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey50", alpha = 0.5, size = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Wall-clock seconds per replicate")
read_run("runtime.tsv") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## cytoJointR convergence

R-hat above 1.01, bulk ESS below 400 or any divergence flags a fit; all fits stay in every metric above.

```{r}
read_run("diagnostics.tsv") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
